name: Fit maps
description: Fit maps: pairs of Content Atlas axes, one axis on the rows, the other on the columns.

sheets.name: Format State Fit
sheets.title: Format × customer state
sheets.description: Which formats suit each customer state. Key is the Formats key and the state columns are the Customer States states. Primary = a state within the format's own Funnel stage (Formats sheet: TOFU = Unaware, Problem-aware; MOFU = Solution-aware, Product-aware; BOFU = Decision, Purchase; Retention = Onboarding through Resurrection; Advocacy = Advocacy). Fit = a further common, practical use of the format at the state. A blank means it is not a default recommendation.

sheets.name: Format Ownership Fit
sheets.title: Format × ownership
sheets.description: How each format is published or delivered under each ownership type. A cell gives a short delivery example; a blank means the format is not generally used that way. Ownership follows the Ownership registry: Owned is a channel you control, Earned is placement won through merit, relationships or newsworthiness (including an accepted guest post), Paid is rented placement, and Shared is co-controlled with a partner, platform, employee or customer. Paid promotion of an owned asset does not change that asset’s ownership: the advertisement is the Paid content unit. Fit depends on what the content communicates; choosing the format alone does not establish fit.

sheets.name: Channel State Fit
sheets.title: Channel × customer state
sheets.description: Which channels support each customer state. Primary = a commonly central channel for completing the stage’s task, not a claim that it is the best channel for every business. Secondary = it supports the stage; its presence alone does not make it central. A blank means it is not generally recommended for that stage. Every channel has been assessed individually against what the audience needs to do at each stage. Fit depends on what the content communicates; choosing the channel alone does not establish fit.

sheets.name: Ownership State Fit
sheets.title: Ownership × customer state
sheets.description: Typical tactics for each ownership type at each customer state. A blank means no tactic is generally recommended for that ownership type at that stage. Tactics depend on what the content communicates; choosing an ownership type alone does not establish fit.

sheets.name: Format Channel Fit
sheets.title: Format × channel
sheets.description: Which formats travel on which channels. Key is the Formats key; the channel columns are the Channels keys. A cell is marked when some surface is marked for both in Format Surface Fit and Channel Surface Fit, both fit a common state (Format State Fit, Channel State Fit), and the format has a delivery (Format Ownership Fit) under the channel's Ownership or Secondary ownership. Grade = the weaker of the format's grade on the strongest shared surface and the strongest shared state (the weaker of the format's and the channel's grade there). A blank means it is not a default recommendation.

sheets.name: State Surface Fit
sheets.title: Surface × customer state
sheets.description: Which surfaces are appropriate at each customer state. Key is the Surfaces registry name and the state columns are the Customer States states. Primary = Customer States names the surface for the state. Secondary = the state is in the surface's Typical funnel fit (TOFU = Unaware, Problem-aware; MOFU = Solution-aware, Product-aware; BOFU = Decision, Purchase; Post-purchase = Onboarding through Advocacy; Any = every state). Fit = a channel that is Primary at the state (Channel State Fit) reaches the surface (Channel Surface Fit). A blank means it is not a default recommendation.

sheets.name: Audience State Fit
sheets.title: Audience × customer state
sheets.description: Fit by audience: an audience group in a buying role. Key is the Audiences registry name and the state columns are the Customer States states. The audience is the reader of content at the state, and the state is that reader's own. Primary = the audience is present and its buying role decides at the state (Customer States Decision maker). Fit = present and involved. A group that carries content to another group's reader (a partner co-hosting or distributing, an employee sharing) is not marked here: Channels Audience groups and Ownership Shared hold it. A blank means it is not a default recommendation. Source map.

sheets.name: Audience Format Fit
sheets.title: Audience × format
sheets.description: Fit by audience: an audience group in a buying role. Key is the Audiences registry name; the format columns are the Formats keys. A cell is marked when the format fits a state where the audience is present (Format State Fit, Audience State Fit). Grade = the weaker of the two cells at the strongest shared state. A blank means it is not a default recommendation.
